mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TIP ( user_id, title, content, hashtag, thumbnail_img, visibility, view_count, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{hashtag}, #{thumbnailImg}, 'PUBLIC', 0, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TB_TIP WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM TB_TIP WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND hashtag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT t.*, u.nickname AS nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TIP_LIKE tl WHERE tl.tip_id = t.tip_id ) AS like_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TIP_COMMENT tc WHERE tc.tip_id = t.tip_id AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS comment_count
FROM TB_TIP t
LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
AND (
t.hashtag LIKE CONCAT('%#', #{countryKeyword}, '%')
)
AND t.hashtag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY t.view_count DESC, t.created_at DESC
ORDER BY like_count DESC, t.created_at DESC
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TIP t WHERE t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
AND (

)
AND t.hashtag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
